page.notes: Greek words in the first and second paragraphs are doubtful: the scan is faint and the accents and some letters could not be read with certainty, so they are marked [?]. The word "fenatuf" is read as senatusconsulta, which the line break and the sense support. Some letters in "Ciceronis" and "Stoici" are not fully legible on the scan. The running head is taken as printed in spaced capitals.
